> > Fact From Story: The Steam Deck OLED delivers on Valve’s original promise.
> > > Fact From Story: The Steam Deck OLED is lighter.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Lighter devices are easier to carry and use.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A device can fulfill a promise if it has improvements.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Improvements to a device can help fulfill a promise made by the company that makes the device.
